user.title: Nibe Price Optimizer
user.description: Requires the Nibe Heat Pump (Modbus) integration and a Nord Pool price sensor with raw_today/raw_tomorrow (HACS Nordpool). Nothing is written to the pump during the trial.

data.grid_fee: Grid fee and other costs per kWh (on top of the spot price)

data_description.grid_fee: Everything you pay per kWh on top of the spot price in the price sensor: grid transfer fee, energy tax, supplier markup – incl. VAT if the price sensor includes VAT.
data_description.trial_days: History from the recorder is imported first, so the trial may finish sooner.
